description: Video handling presets — declarative. App must probe via ffprobe and auto-convert via FFmpeg when incompatible; keep original untouched, stage temp, re-probe, validate before deploy, batch + cancel without corrupt final files.

presets.description: Conservative default TreeFrogUI video preset — DO NOT claim hardware compatibility from source assumptions alone; requires physical R36SX/SF3000 family validation

compatibility_hints.notes: Do NOT assume .mp4/.mkv compatible merely because extension appears in docs. Firmware uses libffplayer hardware decoder; actual supported codecs determined by firmware media plane, not libretro cores.

ffmpeg.command_template: ffmpeg -i <input> -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf scale='min(640,iw)':-2 -r 30 -c:a aac -ar 48000 -ac 2 -movflags +faststart <output>.mp4
ffmpeg.notes: This template is staged to temp and re-probed; only deployed after validation. User can override via declarative preset editing.

probe_adapter.when_incompatible: auto-convert via FFmpeg with staging + re-probe + validation

warnings: PROVISIONAL_UNVALIDATED — do not claim hardware compatibility without physical R36SX/SF3000 family validation
Firmware hardware decoder support varies per device/firmware; this preset is conservative best-effort until device-tested
Never leave corrupt final files on cancel/interrupt — atomic rename only after validation
